## Triage: first grade — `enhancement` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:records` · `pm:queue`. Ruling: **RETIRE** `page:header`'s `breadcrumb` (#18900 A′④: no consumer). The spec half is filed as objectstack-ai/objectstack#20758; this card is the renderer and docs half

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-09-30T02:55Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: lands in `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx` (`PageHeaderRenderer`), a published library ⇒ `domain:ui`. The docs pages move with it.

**Why retire, not enforce.** This is the maintainer's standing rule 「有 ⇒ 补消费端;没有 ⇒ 退役」.
- **No consumer.** The default-true slot has rendered empty on every page header, and nothing fills it.
- **The trail is already drawn.** The console shell draws it once: `AppHeader` renders the breadcrumb path inside `/apps/:appName/*` (read at objectui `origin/main` `c2a8d23c67`). A renderer here would duplicate the shell, not supply something missing.
- **If the maintainer wants a page-level trail after all** (for pages the shell draws none on), that is ENFORCE, and it is said on objectstack-ai/objectstack#20758, where it is re-graded.

**Why p3.** The empty slot is harmless markup, and no author loses anything today.

**Direction for this half.**
- **The renderer.** It stops reading `breadcrumb` and drops both empty `data-page-breadcrumb-slot` divs (`:1508`, `:2343-2347`, `:2379-2380`).
  - Until the spec retirement reaches objectui's install face, an authored `breadcrumb` must still render without error. It is ignored, which is today's behaviour minus an empty div.
  - ⛔ No trail is added.
- **Docs.** `content/docs/layout/page-header.mdx` stops listing the key. objectui#11165's example drops it in that card.
- **Pins:**
  - a `page:header` with `breadcrumb: true` renders no slot;
  - one with the key absent renders the same (the control);
  - the `actions-slot` pins stay green.
- **Order.** The two halves are independent: this half removes only an empty element. objectstack-ai/objectstack#20758 retires the key through ADR-0087, and it also measures the spec's `nav:breadcrumb` component, which has no objectui renderer either.

Claim: PM loop round 8 — `domain:ui` execution seat 2

File surface (triage `5903152845`, ruling RETIRE: the renderer and docs half; the spec half is objectstack-ai/objectstack#20758):
- `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx`, `PageHeaderRenderer`: it stops reading `breadcrumb` (`:1508`) and drops both empty `data-page-breadcrumb-slot` divs (`:2343-2347`, `:2379-2380`). An authored `breadcrumb` still renders without error and is ignored. ⛔ No trail is added.
- The `page-header` registration's declared inputs, if they list `breadcrumb`.
- `content/docs/layout/page-header.mdx`: the key leaves the prop table, the prose and the layout diagram.
- Pins: `breadcrumb: true` renders no slot; the key absent renders the same; the `actions-slot` pins stay green. One changeset (`'@object-ui/components': patch`).
Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (TIER_DEFAULT; `dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` over this surface: no path-derived mandate, at objectstack `288611e3`)
Clause-②: no
Why no: an empty element leaves the render. The spec still accepts the key until objectstack-ai/objectstack#20758 retires it, so no accepted set moves in objectui.
Thread-read: 5903152845
Serial constraints cleared: read 2026-09-30T03:35Z at objectui `origin/main` `c2a8d23c6`. PR objectui#11162 (objectui#3906, `page-header.mdx`) merged as `ce26f401f`. No open PR touches `containers.tsx` or `page-header.mdx`. objectui#11165 (`domain:devx`, the slotted-pages example) drops its own `breadcrumb: true` in its own file.
